patronOf.en-US: The priest gathers the prayer of all
patronOf.pt-BR: O sacerdote reúne a oração de todos

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, vosso Filho, que é Deus, e convosco vive e reina, na unidade do Espírito Santo, por todos os séculos dos séculos.

meta.basis: After 'Let us pray' and a brief silence, the priest says the Collect 'with hands extended' (GIRM 127), at the chair, with all standing (GIRM 43); the Missal is kept next to the chair (GIRM 118a) and the acolyte presents the book to the priest there (GIRM 189). The excerpt is the Trinitarian conclusion GIRM 54 gives for a Collect addressed to the Father.
